events.title: 🚛 PROSPICE Joins Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Steam Next Fest starts today, and PROSPICE is joining the festival with its demo!We released the demo during The Triple-i Initiative earlier this month, and the response has been incredible. 99% of our Steam reviews are positive! We're really grateful to everyone who's taken the time to play and share their thoughts.If you haven't visited the island yet, the demo is waiting for you. events.title: Demo Build 168 patch notes
events.summary: Build 168- Moved fuel tank upgrade to lvl 2 so you can purchase it in the demo- Went through all cargo and modified its weight, so overloaded truck has more noticable handling differences- Added exit truck hint if player somehow skips the tutorial popup- Added POV switch tutorial popup- Fixed rendering resolution below 70% only showing up in-game and not in the main menu

events.title: Demo build 156 patch notes
events.summary: Build 166- Fixed some minor bugs in the POI spawn system- Modified placement of some semi-random POIs to be easier to discover

events.title: Demo build 165 patch notes
events.summary: Build 165- Fixed some objects breaking precise placement mode- New threat system. Threat level grows with mission progression, introducing more threats into the world- Rework of POI system: • Points of interest should now spawn closer around the player, and keep track of engagement • Ichor teardrops are now spawned in a radius instead of pre-set location • Ichor teardrops spawn x2 as often at night • New point of interest type: necroferric fog, which only spawns after your threat level reaches s

events.title: Demo build 161 patch notes
events.summary: Build 161- Optimized terrain rendering, low and medium settings should see some fps boost- Fixed aggressive LOD changes on terrain

events.title: Demo Build 160 patch notes
events.summary: Build 160- Added new hidden toolbox somewhere on the coast- Replaced Japanese font- Incresed parking brake power again- The game now checks for missing inputs between game versions and restores defaults if new key bindings were introduced- Precise cargo placement system: while holding cargo, hold your zoom button (right mouse button, right trigger) and look at the truck bed. Press use (E or X) to place the cargo and automatically fasten it- Improved repair x-ray shader while I was at it- Cage on

events.title: Build 147 patchnotes
events.summary: Build 147- Fixed the entire game becoming totally black under specific weather conditions- Added new game option directly in the main menu- Pressing quit from the pause menu now brings you back to the main menu instead of quitting the game- If you reset your savefile through the main menu, it should create a backup savefile just in case

events.title: Demo Build 134 patch notes
events.summary: Build 134- Fixed rare bug which caused the game to drop to single-digit framerates after opening and closing the PDA (hopefully)- Fixed rare bug which caused the truck to vanish (hopefully)- Buffed truck perforamce on inclines a little- Base triangulation error is 45% stronger now- Rain further degrades triangulation quality- Fixed collider which prevents players from entering the cave- Increased XP requrement for level 2 to 1500 XP

events.title: Build 132 cumulative patch notes
events.summary: Here's a list of changes since the last patch notes post on steam, which was for the 100th build.Build 132- Modified clutch logic so truck hunts for gear less in auto mode- Fixed mud particles spawning when turning wheels while stationary- Improved mud particle VFX- Fixed some LODs- Locked max level at 2 for the demo- Tweaked engine audio- Fixed a whole bunch of typos- Added French localisation- Improved main menu visuals- Corkboard at outpost populated with pictures player took during gameplay-

events.title: Prospice will be at The Triple-i Initiative on October 8!
events.summary: The Triple-i Initiative is back on October 8 at 9am PT / 6pm CEST, and we’re excited to share that Prospice will be part of the show!The showcase is 45 minutes of back-to-back trailers featuring world premieres, gameplay reveals, launch dates, demo drops, and more.No hosts. No ads. No sponsors. Just games.Watch live on YouTube Watch live on TwitchThe showcase will also be streamed right here on Steam. See you there! 👀

events.title: Thanks for Playing Prospice. Tell Us What You Think!
events.summary: THANK YOU FOR JOINING US THIS WEEKEND!The latest Prospice closed playtest is now over, and we want to thank everyone who took part.Whether you spent the weekend exploring the island, testing the new build, checking out the latest changes, or only had time for a short session, we really appreciate you joining us.Now we’d love to hear how it went.YOUR FEEDBACK MATTERSIf you participated in the playtest, please take a few minutes to share your thoughts with us.There’s no minimum playtime required.
